gizmo.title: Isikhumbuzo sokuziqwalasela
gizmo.description: Cela umfundi acinge ngebakala okanye imvakalelo yakhe, kwaye unike isikhumbuzo sokuzilungisa esisekelwe kuphendulo.

configure.title: Uhlobo lokufaka
configure.description: Indlela umfundi axela ngayo ukuba wenza njani. Zombini zisebenzisa isikali esingu-0 ukuya ku-4 (ibakala: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; imvakalelo: phantsi kakhulu=0 ukuya kuhle kakhulu=4).

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Umbuzo kumfundi. Shiya engenanto ukusebenzisa oqhelekileyo woluhlobo lokufaka.

configure.title: Izikhumbuzo
configure.description: Impendulo ebonisiweyo kuluhlu lweempendulo. Kusetyenziswa uluhlu lokuqala olufanayo.
